open.description: The controlled open state of the dialog

modal.description: Whether to prevent pointer interaction outside the element and hide all content below it

skip-animation-on-mount.description: Whether to allow the initial presence animation.

as-child.description: Apply the props to the first child element instead of this element.

debug.description: Log state transitions, events and prop changes to the console. Applies to descendants too.

openchange.description: Fired when the dialog's open state changes

triggervaluechange.description: Fired when the active trigger changes

escapekeydown.description: Fired when the escape key is pressed

requestdismiss.description: Fired when this layer is closed due to a parent layer being closed

pointerdownoutside.description: Fired when the pointer is pressed down outside the component

focusoutside.description: Fired when the focus is moved outside the component

interactoutside.description: Fired when an interaction happens outside the component

initialFocusEl.description:
Element to receive focus when the dialog is opened.
Return `false` to skip moving focus, or `null` to use the default.

finalFocusEl.description: Element to receive focus when the dialog is closed

ids.description: The ids of the elements in the dialog. Useful for composition.

ready.description: Resolves once the element's machine has started, so `api`, state and parts are in place.

api.description: The Zag API of the component. `undefined` until it connects.
